items.title: I will have more Saturday from my 1-on-1 locker room conversation with Paolo Banchero, but the #Magic forward told @orlandosentinel.com tonight he feels “pretty confident” his sore right ankle is “nothing too major.”
items.author: Jason Beede
items.body_excerpt:
I will have more Saturday from my 1-on-1 locker room conversation with Paolo Banchero, but the #Magic forward told @orlandosentinel.com tonight he feels “pretty confident” his sore right ankle is “nothing too major.”

As Sean Sweeney said, Orlando will continue to evaluate him.
